defense_news.title: Inside MSI’s Next Generation of Counter-Drone Defense

defense_news.title: US Air Force adopts new Force Design focusing on sensors and autonomy
defense_news.summary: The Air Force's new Force Design 2026 outlines a shift toward artificial intelligence, autonomy and integrated sensors to counter emerging threats.

defense_news.title: Judges close part of ICC Afghanistan investigations that could look at US troops
defense_news.summary: The International Criminal Court will close investigations into Afghanistan that previously looked at alleged crimes by U.S. troops and focus only on actions of the Taliban.
